energy.title: Fleet energy

energy.partialHelp: Energy is estimated from each node's live GPU and CPU readings. {{stale}}A node that is offline, unreachable or not reporting power stops the fleet total from being measured for that time, so 24h coverage drops. It recovers by itself once the node reports again.
energy.barsAria: Hourly estimated watts for the last 24 hours, with gaps shown empty

tokens.title: LLM token totals
tokens.ledgerWholeFleet: Counted by sparkDash since tracking began, whole fleet
tokens.ledgerTitle: Counted by sparkDash since tracking began, filtered by the selected range. It survives engine restarts, so it can be larger than the engine's own Generated counter.
tokens.segmentAria: Generated, cached prefill and computed prefill token share
tokens.none: No tokens recorded in this period.

inference.capReached: Activity cap reached; counts may be incomplete.
inference.footnote: In flight includes queueing, prefill and decode; not GPU slots or per-key tok/s. Display labels only; no API keys or prompts.

spark.parallelTitle: {{count}} requests decode in parallel on this engine
spark.noModelOnHeadShort: No model loaded on the head
spark.pickHead: Pick its head in Edit Spark to see the model here
spark.perStreamPrefill: {{count}} tok/s per request — effective (incl. cached tokens)
spark.promptProcessingStrata: A prompt is being processed; no current prefill rate is available.
spark.promptProcessing: A prompt is being processed. The engine reports its speed only when the request finishes.
spark.strataDecodeTitle: Live sliding-window decode rate. When that window is unavailable, the active-slot mean sums each active slot’s generated tokens divided by its elapsed time since first token; it excludes prefill time.
spark.strataPrefillTitle: Engine-reported mean for computed/new prompt tokens. It may be from an earlier prefill and is not an aggregate across slots.
spark.perStreamTitle: Average decode throughput of one running stream (1 / mean seconds per output token). Only engines that publish a per-token latency histogram report it.
spark.perStreamPrefillTitle: Effective prefill rate of one request (prompt tokens ÷ prefill seconds over finished requests). The prompt counter includes prefix-cache tokens, so this is an effective speed, not raw GPU speed; it is held between completions.
spark.runtimeTitle: Native engine activity and estimated uncached tokens awaiting prefill.
spark.loadedTitle: {{name}} · loaded model; throughput shown for the monitored endpoint above
